items.title: File Widerspruch against the refusal
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Tue 2 Dec 2025 (posting day). Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG a posted authority letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 6 Dec 2025 (this day is not shifted for delivery purposes). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts running on 7 Dec 2025 and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day, i.e. Tue 6 Jan 2026. Since 6 Jan 2026 (Heilige Drei Könige) is a public holiday in Bayern, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Wed 7 Jan 2026 (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG).
